title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #10

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the kingdom of God mean? (1 mark)
   A. God's rule in the hearts of people who obey Him
   B. A school
   C. A country in Europe
   D. A big farm

2. A child lives with a grandmother and an aunt because her parents work far away. Is this a family? (1 mark)
   A. No, it is only a group of neighbours
   B. Yes, every family that cares for a child should be respected
   C. No, only parents and children make a family
   D. Only if they are rich

3. Who is a needy person? (1 mark)
   A. Only adults
   B. Someone who lacks important things like food or clothing
   C. Only foreigners
   D. Someone who is wealthy

4. How old was Abram when God changed his name? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 120
   C. 99
   D. 75

5. What did the angel tell Zechariah to name the baby? (1 mark)
   A. Gabriel
   B. Jesus
   C. Zechariah
   D. John

6. What did Samson use to kill the lion? (1 mark)
   A. A sword
   B. His bare hands
   C. A spear
   D. A stone

7. Which of these is a good use of your talents? (1 mark)
   A. Helping others with them
   B. Boasting about them
   C. Using them to hurt people
   D. Hiding them always

8. Who was told by an angel that they would have a son called Samson? (1 mark)
   A. Joshua
   B. His parents
   C. Balak
   D. Ruth

9. Antioch lies north of Jerusalem. In which direction would you travel from Jerusalem to reach Antioch? (1 mark)
   A. East
   B. South
   C. North
   D. West

10. Which action shows that we care for God's creation? (1 mark)
   A. Cutting trees for fun
   B. Planting trees and saving water
   C. Wasting food
   D. Hurting animals

11. What does "Give us today our daily bread" mean? (1 mark)
   A. We ask God for what we need each day
   B. We ask for gold
   C. We ask for money
   D. We ask for a party

12. Why does the Bible say "fruit" and not "fruits"? (1 mark)
   A. There is only one
   B. It refers to mangoes
   C. It is a mistake
   D. The qualities belong together

13. What should you do if you make a wrong choice? (1 mark)
   A. Admit it, say sorry and try to put it right
   B. Hide it
   C. Repeat it
   D. Blame others

14. What is a lie? (1 mark)
   A. A true story
   B. A song
   C. A false statement told to deceive
   D. A prayer

15. What is a patriarch? (1 mark)
   A. The father and leader of a family or nation
   B. A prophet
   C. A soldier
   D. A king

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe how the woman searched for the coin and what she did when she found it. (4 marks)

17. Name two digital devices used at home or school. (2 marks)

18. Describe how the story of the shepherd boy and the wolf shows the results of lying. (4 marks)

19. Explain how the parable shows God's love for the sinner and how a child can respond. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — God's rule in the hearts of people who obey Him
   God's kingdom is His rule.

2. B — Yes, every family that cares for a child should be respected
   Families come in different forms, and each deserves love and respect.

3. B — Someone who lacks important things like food or clothing
   Needy people lack basic things.

4. C — 99
   Genesis 17:1 says he was ninety-nine.

5. D — John
   Luke 1:13 says his name would be John.

6. B — His bare hands
   He tore it apart with his bare hands.

7. A — Helping others with them
   Talents are gifts from God meant to serve others.

8. B — His parents
   The angel of the Lord appeared to Samson's parents.

9. C — North
   To reach a place that lies to the north, you travel north.

10. B — Planting trees and saving water
   Caring for the environment honours the Creator.

11. A — We ask God for what we need each day
   It refers to daily needs.

12. D — The qualities belong together
   The nine qualities are one fruit.

13. A — Admit it, say sorry and try to put it right
   Being honest about mistakes lets us make things right.

14. C — A false statement told to deceive
   A lie is not true and is told to deceive.

15. A — The father and leader of a family or nation
   Abraham, Isaac and Jacob are called patriarchs.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: She lit a lamp, swept the house, searched carefully until she found it, then called her friends and neighbours to rejoice with her.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Phone, tablet, computer, TV, radio.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: The boy lied twice that a wolf was coming. Villagers came and found nothing. When a real wolf came, nobody believed him. Lies destroy trust.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

19. (5 marks)
   Answer: God searches for lost people like the woman for her coin. He is happy when a person repents. A child can respond by saying sorry to God, turning away from wrong, living a righteous life, and caring for others who go astray.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's search, 1 for God's joy, 1 for saying sorry, 1 for righteous living, 1 for caring for others.
